name: Dietrich Stolz
original_name: ディートリヒ・シュトルツ
source:
Descendant of German nobility on his grandfather's side, Dietrich is the Resident Minister in Anatolia.
As a longtime friend of Christof's, he's known Eli since she was a child.
With dignified looks and an affable personality, he has many female admirers.
